description: Chronic stroke lesion segmentation model. Takes a single T1-weighted NIfTI brain MRI and returns axial-slice lesion overlay images, an optional 3D lesion rendering, and per-lesion volume/location statistics. Based on SynthStroke (MONAI 3D UNet trained with synthetic data, MELBA 2025) for robust cross-protocol stroke segmentation.
disease: stroke, chronic stroke, ischemic stroke, brain lesion, stroke lesion segmentation, infarct
